note: Algeria: nationals of Libya, Malaysia, Mali, Mauritania, the Sahrawi Republic, Seychelles and Tunisia enter without a visa for 3 months, Hong Kong's for 14 days (since 25 November 2025); everyone else needs a visa from a mission (Moroccans since 26 September 2024; Israelis are refused, taken as a visa). A visa on arrival for organised tours to the southern provinces isn't modelled. Read from Wikipedia's copy. Checked on 2026-11-03 against the Foreign Ministry's missions in London, Abu Dhabi and Washington, which confirmed the exempt nationalities (London's list adds the Maldives, Abu Dhabi's leaves out Libya); both lists still name Morocco, so they predate its visa of 26 September 2024 and weren't taken to add the Maldives. No mission gives the exempt nationals' stay, which stands on Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of Algeria
sources.said: Visitors to Algeria must obtain a visa from one of the Algerian diplomatic missions or on arrival from organized tours unless they are citizens from one of the visa-exempt countries. ... may enter Algeria without a visa for the following period: 3 months Libya Malaysia Mali Mauritania Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic Seychelles Tunisia 14 days Hong Kong ... 26 September 2024: Morocco

sources.title: Consulate General of Algeria in London (Ministry of Foreign Affairs, mfa.gov.dz): Entry visa to Algeria
sources.said: Visa terms All non-Algerians need to apply for a visa to enter Algeria. There are exceptions for some nationals of foreign countries, listed below, who are exempted from visas: All Nationals from :Libya, Malaysia, Maldives, Mali, Mauritania, Morocco, Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic, Seychelles, Tunisia.

sources.title: Embassy of Algeria in Abu Dhabi (mfa.gov.dz): Entry visa to Algeria
sources.said: The nationals of the following countries are exempted from a prior visa: Tunisia, Morocco, Western Sahara, Mauritania, Mali, Malaysia and Seychelles.

sources.title: Embassy of Algeria in Washington (mfa.gov.dz): Entry visa to Algeria
sources.said: Except those not subject to this formality, foreigners wishing to travel to Algeria must previously obtain a visa from diplomatic and consular posts. ... Duration of stay: the maximum duration of stay authorized at each entry into Algeria is 90 days, which may, exceptionally, be extended not to exceed 90 days. The actual cumulative stay may not exceed 180 days per year.
